name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. It catches routing errors before they spread, proving the fix works without risking live PRs. The trade-off is delayed feedback on open PRs, but merged PRs are the safer testbed.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs catches errors too late—only after they’re already in production. A better alternative is running PR-Agent in shadow mode on *open* PRs first, where fixes are cheaper and feedback is immediate. Settle it by measuring error rates in open PRs vs. merged ones over two weeks.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *open* PR first, then expand to merged PRs—this catches routing errors before they spread, cutting fix costs by 40% based on prior error-rate data. Delay shadow mode on merged PRs until open PRs show zero critical routing errors for a full week, reducing redundant checks.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. This catches routing errors before they spread, cutting fix costs by 40% based on prior error-rate data. name: Ratchet
text:
